assumptions: The injected V1X camera instance remains the sole mutable camera and continuous-distance authority.
Selection, parent lineage, surface target and history tokens are observed as read-only context and never admitted as world mutations.
Raw wheel line/page normalization is bounded before delegation to the frozen V1X semantic-distance conversion functions.
Executable rewind is defined only for controller-observed operations whose before/after camera digests form one contiguous verified journal.
The convergence-owned Living adapter is the only product composition point that binds this controller into the primary viewport; this lane does not own or replace that adapter.
limitations: Camera paths, reference-frame transforms and cinematic interpolation are presentation-only and are not physical trajectories, orbital phases or scientific position measurements.
Hierarchical local frames preserve bounded reversible presentation context; this provider does not claim one globally precise floating-point coordinate across cosmic-to-microscopic scales.
External camera commands, external selection observations and spatial mutations that invalidate a reference-frame return witness fail closed by discarding stale reverse capability.
Rewind rollback is compensating presentation recovery over the frozen camera API; it is not a canonical transaction and does not rewrite history.

This additive lane does not commandeer the convergence-owned Living renderer or central input router; exact-artifact browser evidence is therefore consumed from the convergence-owned Living path rather than created through a second viewport.

fidelity.validity: Bounded continuous presentation travel over the frozen V1X camera, semantic-distance and reference-frame authorities, with fail-closed reversible operation journaling and verified anchor restoration.
fidelity.resolution: Frame-paced accumulated distance/look intents, bounded local translation, explicit wheel unit normalization, hierarchical reference-frame handoffs, nested bounded anchors and exact-within-tolerance rewind for observed presentation operations.
fidelity.uncertainty: Interpolation timing and camera path are perceptual product choices; scientific distance, orbital phase and unsupported micro continuity remain outside this provider's authority. Rewind correctness is conditional on a contiguous observed command stream, stable selection context and the frozen V1X reference-return semantics.
